name: Eliezer
overview: The name Eliezer appears multiple times in Scripture, associated with various individuals who served distinct roles in Israel's history. Notably, Eliezer was Abraham's trusted steward, highlighting faithful service within God's covenant family (Genesis 15:2). Another Eliezer, the son of Moses, signifies God's help and deliverance (Exodus 18:4). Post-exilic records mention several men named Eliezer among priests, Levites, and leaders, emphasizing their roles in the restoration and spiritual leadership of Israel after captivity (Ezra 8:16; 10:18, 23, 31). These references collectively underscore God's providential care through faithful servants across different eras.
